40020354.author: पदार्थः
40020354.content: अथ then, लोकेश्वरोत्सृष्टा sent forth by the Lord of the worlds, तत्र there, कालेन केनचित् after some time, निद्रा sleep, समभवत् arose, तीव्रा intense, कुम्भकर्णस्य of Kumbhakarna, रूपिणी embodied.

40020354.author: Translation
40020354.content: Then, after some time, an intense, embodied sleep, sent forth by the Lord of the worlds, arose there for Kumbhakarna.

40020355.author: पदार्थः
40020355.content: ततः then, भ्रातरम् to his brother, आसीनम् seated, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, अब्रवीत् spoke, वचः words, निद्रा sleep, माम् me, बाधते afflicts, राजन् O King, कारयस्व cause to be built, मम my, आलयम् dwelling.

40020355.author: Translation
40020355.content: Then, Kumbhakarna spoke to his seated brother, saying, "O King, sleep afflicts me; please have a dwelling built for me."

40020356.author: पदार्थः
40020356.content: विनियुक्ताः appointed, ततः then, राज्ञा by the king, शिल्पिनः artisans, विश्वकर्मवत् like Vishvakarma, विस्तीर्णम् wide, योजनम् a yojana, शुभ्रम् splendid, ततः from that, द्विगुणम् double, आयतम् long.

40020356.author: Translation
40020356.content: Then, artisans like Vishvakarma were appointed by the king to construct a splendid dwelling, one yojana wide and twice that in length.

40020357.author: पदार्थः
40020357.content: दर्शनीयम् beautiful to behold, निराबाधम् unobstructed, कुम्भकर्णस्य for Kumbhakarna, चक्रिरे they made, स्फाटिकैः with crystal, काञ्चनैः with gold, चित्रैः variegated, स्तम्भैः with pillars, सर्वत्र everywhere, शोभितम् adorned.

40020357.author: Translation
40020357.content: They built for Kumbhakarna a beautiful and unobstructed dwelling, adorned everywhere with variegated pillars of crystal and gold.

40020358.author: पदार्थः
40020358.content: वैडूर्यकृतसोपानं having steps made of lapis lazuli, किङ्किणीजालकं a network of small bells, तथा and, दान्ततोरणविन्यस्तं adorned with ivory archways, वज्रस्फटिकवेदिकम् having platforms of diamond and crystal.

40020358.author: Translation
40020358.content: The structure featured steps made of lapis lazuli, a network of small bells, ivory archways, and platforms of diamond and crystal.

40020359.author: पदार्थः
40020359.content: मनोहरं charming, सर्वसुखं providing all comforts, कारयामास caused to be made, राक्षसः the demon, सर्वत्र everywhere, सुखदं giving comfort, नित्यं always, मेरोः of Mount Meru, पुण्यां sacred, गुहामिव like a cave.

40020359.author: Translation
40020359.content: The demon (Ravana) had a charming and universally comfortable dwelling built, which was always pleasant, like a sacred cave on Mount Meru.

40020360.author: पदार्थः
40020360.content: तत्र there, निद्रां sleep, समाविष्टः overcome by, कुम्भकर्णो Kumbhakarna, महाबलः the greatly powerful, बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, शयानो sleeping, न not, प्रबुद्ध्यते awakens.

40020360.author: Translation
40020360.content: There, the greatly powerful Kumbhakarna, overcome by sleep, remained sleeping for many thousands of years without awakening.

40020361.author: पदार्थः
40020361.content: निद्राभिभूते when overcome by sleep, तु indeed, तदा then, कुम्भकर्णे Kumbhakarna, दशाननः Dashanana (Ravana), देवर्षियक्षगन्धर्वान् gods, sages, Yakshas, and Gandharvas, सञ्जघ्ने killed, हि indeed, निरङ्कुशः unrestrained.

40020361.author: Translation
40020361.content: When Kumbhakarna was overcome by sleep, the unrestrained Dashanana (Ravana) then indeed killed gods, sages, Yakshas, and Gandharvas.

40020362.author: पदार्थः
40020362.content: उद्यानानि gardens, च and, चित्राणि beautiful, नन्दनादीनि Nandana and others, यानि which, च and, तानि those, गत्वा having gone, सुसङक्रुद्धो very enraged, भिनत्ति broke, स्म (past tense indicator), दशाननः Dashanana (Ravana).

40020362.author: Translation
40020362.content: Dashanana (Ravana), having gone to those beautiful gardens, including Nandana and others, very enraged, proceeded to destroy them.

40020363.author: पदार्थः
40020363.content: नदीं river, गज इव like an elephant, क्रीडन् playing, वृक्षान् trees, वायुर् इव like wind, क्षिपन् throwing down, नगान् mountains, व्रज्र इव like a thunderbolt, उत्सृष्टो hurled, विध्वंसयति destroys, राक्षसः the demon.

40020363.author: Translation
40020363.content: The demon destroys everything, playing with rivers like an elephant, throwing down trees like the wind, and shattering mountains like a hurled thunderbolt.

40020364.author: पदार्थः
40020364.content: तथावृत्तं such conduct, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having known, दशग्रीवं Daśagrīva's, धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth (Kubera), कुलानुरूपं befitting the family, धर्मज्ञो knowing righteousness, वृत्तं conduct, संस्मृत्य having remembered, च and, आत्मनः his own.

40020364.author: Translation
40020364.content: Kubera, the lord of wealth and a knower of righteousness, having learned of Daśagrīva's conduct and remembering his own family's appropriate behavior, decided to act.

40020365.author: पदार्थः
40020365.content: सौभ्रात्रदर्शनार्थं for the sake of showing brotherly affection, तु indeed, दूतं a messenger, वैश्रवणस्तदा Vaiśravaṇa (Kubera) then, लङ्कां to Lanka, सम्प्रेषयामास sent, दशग्रीवस्य of Daśagrīva, वै indeed, हितम् beneficial.

40020365.author: Translation
40020365.content: Then, Kubera, wishing to demonstrate brotherly affection and for Daśagrīva's welfare, sent a messenger to Lanka.

40020366.author: पदार्थः
40020366.content: स he (the messenger), गत्वा having gone, नगरीं to the city, लङ्कां Lanka, आससाद met, विभीषणम् Vibhīṣaṇa, मानितस्तेन honored by him, धर्मेण properly, पृष्टश्चागमनं and questioned about his arrival, प्रति regarding.

40020366.author: Translation
40020366.content: Having arrived in the city of Lanka, the messenger met Vibhīṣaṇa, who honored him properly and inquired about the purpose of his visit.

40020367.author: पदार्थः
40020367.content: पृष्ट्वा having asked, च and, कुशलं welfare, राज्ञो of the king, ज्ञातीनां of the relatives, च and, बिभीषणः Vibhīṣaṇa, सभायां in the assembly, दर्शयामास showed, तमासीनं him seated, दशाननम् Daśānana (Rāvaṇa).

40020367.author: Translation
40020367.content: After inquiring about the welfare of the king and his relatives, Vibhīṣaṇa led the messenger to the assembly hall where Daśānana was seated.

40020368.author: पदार्थः
40020368.content: स he (the messenger), दृष्ट्वा having seen, तत्र there, राजानं the king, दीप्यमानं shining, स्वतेजसा with his own splendor, जयेति "Victory!", वाचा with words, सम्पूज्य having honored, तूष्णीं silently, समभिवर्तत stood.

40020368.author: Translation
40020368.content: Upon seeing the king shining with his own splendor, the messenger honored him with words of "Victory!" and then stood silently.

40020369.author: पदार्थः
40020369.content: तम् him, तत्र there, उत्तमपर्यङ्के on an excellent couch, वरास्तरणशोभिते adorned with excellent coverings, उपविष्टम् seated, दशग्रीवम् Dashagriva (Ravana), दूतः the messenger, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40020369.author: Translation
40020369.content: The messenger then spoke words to Dashagriva, who was seated there on an excellent couch adorned with fine coverings.

40020370.author: पदार्थः
40020370.content: राजन् O King, वदामि I tell, ते you, सर्वम् all, भ्राता brother, तव your, यत् what, अब्रवीत् spoke, उभयोः of both (of us), सदृशम् befitting, वीर O hero, वृत्तस्य of conduct, च and, कुलस्य of lineage, च and.

40020370.author: Translation
40020370.content: O King, I will tell you everything that your brother spoke, which is befitting of the conduct and lineage of both of us, O hero.

40020371.author: पदार्थः
40020371.content: साधु enough, पर्याप्तम् enough, एतावत् this much, कृतः done, चारित्रसङ्ग्रहः accumulation of character (deeds), साधु proper, धर्मे in righteousness, व्यवस्थानम् adherence, क्रियताम् let it be done, यदि if, शक्यते it is possible.

40020371.author: Translation
40020371.content: Enough of this accumulation of deeds; it is proper that adherence to righteousness be established, if it is possible.

40020372.author: पदार्थः
40020372.content: दृष्टम् seen, मे by me, नन्दनम् Nandana (garden), भग्नम् destroyed, ऋषयः sages, निहताः killed, श्रुताः heard, देवतानाम् of the gods, समुद्योगः preparation, त्वत्तः from you, राजन् O King, मम by me, श्रुतः heard.

40020372.author: Translation
40020372.content: I have seen the Nandana garden destroyed, I have heard that sages were killed, and I have heard from you, O King, about the gods' preparations.

40020373.author: पदार्थः
40020373.content: निराकृतः rejected, च and, बहुशः many times, त्वया by you, अहम् I, राक्षसाधिप O lord of Rakshasas, अपराद्धाः those who have erred, हि indeed, बाल्यात् due to childishness, च and, रमणीयाः should be cherished, स्वबान्धवाः one's own relatives.

40020373.author: Translation
40020373.content: O lord of Rakshasas, I have been disregarded by you many times, yet one's own relatives, even if they have erred due to childishness, should indeed be cherished.

40020374.author: पदार्थः
40020374.content: अहं I, तु indeed, हिमवत्पृष्ठं to the peak of Himavat, गतो went, धर्मम् dharma, उपासितुम् to practice, रौद्रं fierce, व्रत्तं vow, समास्थाय having undertaken, नियतः self-controlled, नियतेन्द्रियः with controlled senses.

40020374.author: Translation
40020374.content: I indeed went to the peak of the Himalayas to practice dharma, having undertaken a severe vow, disciplined and with my senses controlled.

40020375.author: पदार्थः
40020375.content: तत्र there, देवः the god, मया by me, दृष्टः was seen, सह with, देव्या the goddess, मया by me, प्रभुः the lord, सव्यं left, चक्षुः eye, मया by me, दैवात् by chance, तत्र there, देव्यां on the goddess, निपातितम् was cast.

40020375.author: Translation
40020375.content: There, I saw the Lord, the god Shiva, with the goddess Parvati, and by chance, my left eye fell upon the goddess.

40020376.author: पदार्थः
40020376.content: का who, नु indeed, इयं this, स्यात् might be, इति thus, शुभा beautiful one, न not, खलु indeed, अन्येन by another, हेतुना reason, रूपं form, हि indeed, अनुपमं incomparable, कृत्वा having assumed, रुद्राणी Rudra's consort, तत्र there, तिष्ठति stands.

40020376.author: Translation
40020376.content: I wondered, "Who might this beautiful one be?" and not for any other reason, for Rudra's consort, Parvati, stood there having assumed an incomparable form.

40020377.author: पदार्थः
40020377.content: देव्या by the goddess, दिव्यप्रभावेण by divine power, दग्धं burnt, सव्यं left, मम my, ईक्षणम् eye, रेणुध्वस्तम् dust-covered, इव like, ज्योतिः light, पिङ्गुलत्वम् yellowish-brown color, उपागतम् attained.

40020377.author: Translation
40020377.content: By the divine power of the goddess, my left eye was burnt, and it became yellowish-brown, like a flame obscured by dust.

40020378.author: पदार्थः
40020378.content: ततः then, अहं I, अन्यत् another, विस्तीर्णं expansive, गत्वा having gone, तस्य of that, गिरेः mountain's, तटम् slope, तूष्णीं silently, वर्षशतानि hundreds of years, अष्टौ eight, समाधारं observed, महाव्रतम् great vow.

40020378.author: Translation
40020378.content: Then, I went to another expansive slope of that mountain and silently observed a great vow for eight hundred years.

40020379.author: पदार्थः
40020379.content: तस्मिन् that, नियमे vow, समाप्ते when completed, तत्र there, प्रभुः the lord, देवो महेश्वरः god Maheshvara, प्रीतः pleased, प्रीतेन मनसा with a gladdened mind, इदं वाक्यं these words, प्राह spoke.

40020379.author: Translation
40020379.content: When that austerity was completed, the lord Maheshvara, well pleased, spoke these words there with a gladdened mind.

40020380.author: पदार्थः
40020380.content: पैङ्गल्यं yellowness, यत् which, अवाप्तं obtained, हि indeed, देव्या by the goddess, रूपनिरीक्षणात् from seeing (her) form, प्रीतो ऽस्मि I am pleased, तव your, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, तपसा by penance, अनेन by this, सुव्रत O one of good vows.

40020380.author: Translation
40020380.content: O knower of dharma, O one of good vows, I am indeed pleased by this penance of yours, which resulted in the yellowness (of your eye) from gazing upon the goddess's form.

40020381.author: पदार्थः
40020381.content: मया च and by me, एतद् व्रतं this vow, चीर्णं performed, त्वया च एव and by you alone, धनाधिप O lord of wealth, तृतीयः a third, पुरुषो person, न अस्ति there is not, यः who, चरेत् would perform, व्रतम् a vow, ईदृशम् such.

40020381.author: Translation
40020381.content: O lord of wealth, this vow has been performed by me and by you alone, for there is no third person who could perform such a vow.

40020382.author: पदार्थः
40020382.content: व्रतं vow, सुनिश्चयं very firm, हि indeed, एतत् this, मया हि indeed by me, उत्पादितं originated, पुरा formerly, तत् therefore, सखित्वं friendship, मया with me, सौम्य O gentle one, रोचयस्व desire, धनेश्वर O lord of wealth.

40020382.author: Translation
40020382.content: This very firm vow was indeed originated by me in the past, therefore, O gentle lord of wealth, desire friendship with me.

40020383.author: पदार्थः
40020383.content: तपसा by penance, निर्जितः च एव conquered and indeed, सखा friend, भव become, मम my, अनघ O sinless one, देव्या by the goddess, दग्धं burnt, प्रभावेण by the power, यत् च and which, सव्यं left, तव your, ईक्षणम् eye.

40020383.author: Translation
40020383.content: O sinless one, having been conquered by your penance, become my friend, especially since your left eye was burnt by the power of the goddess.

40020384.author: पदार्थः
40020384.content: एकाक्षिपिङ्गलेति Ekakshipingala, एव indeed, नाम name, स्थास्यति will remain, शाश्वतम् eternal, एवम् thus, तेन by him, सखित्वम् friendship, च and, प्राप्य having obtained, अनुज्ञाम् permission, च and, शङ्करात् from Shankara.

40020384.author: Translation
40020384.content: Thus, the name Ekakshipingala will remain eternal, and having obtained friendship and permission from Lord Shankara, Kubera spoke.

40020385.author: पदार्थः
40020385.content: आगत्य having come, च and, श्रुतः heard, अयम् this, मे by me, तव your, पापविनिश्चयः sinful resolve.

40020385.author: Translation
40020385.content: And having come here, I have heard of this sinful resolve of yours.

40020386.author: पदार्थः
40020386.content: तत् therefore, अधर्मिष्ठसंयोगात् from unrighteous union, निवर्त turn back, कुलदूषणात् from disgracing your family, चिन्त्यते is being thought of, हि indeed, वधोपायः means of killing, सर्षिसङ्घैः by the sages along with their groups, सुरैः by the gods, तव your.

40020386.author: Translation
40020386.content: Therefore, desist from this unrighteous union which disgraces your family, for indeed, the gods along with the groups of sages are contemplating a means to kill you.

40020387.author: पदार्थः
40020387.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, क्रुद्धसंरक्तलोचनः with eyes red with anger, हस्तौ hands, दन्तान् teeth, च and, सम्पीड्य having pressed/gnashed, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40020387.author: Translation
40020387.content: Thus addressed, Dashagriva, with eyes red with anger, gnashed his teeth and spoke these words.

40020388.author: पदार्थः
40020388.content: विज्ञातम् understood, ते your, मया by me, दूत O messenger, वाक्यम् words, यस्य whose, प्रभाषसे you speak, न not, एतत् this, त्वम् you, असि are, न not, एव indeed, असौ he, भ्रात्रा by the brother, येन by whom, असि you are, चोदितः instigated.

40020388.author: Translation
40020388.content: O messenger, I have understood your words which you speak and whose message it is; you are not this person, nor is he the brother by whom you claim to be instigated.

40020389.author: पदार्थः
40020389.content: हितं beneficial, न not, एष this (one), मम my, एतत् this, हि indeed, ब्रवीति speaks, धनरक्षकः the protector of wealth (Kubera), महेश्वरसखित्वं friendship with Maheśvara (Shiva), तु but, मूढ foolish one, श्रावयते makes (me) hear, किल indeed.

40020389.author: Translation
40020389.content: This protector of wealth (Kubera) is not speaking what is beneficial for me; rather, this fool is indeed making me hear about his friendship with Maheśvara.

40020390.author: पदार्थः
40020390.content: न not, च and, इदं this, क्षमणीयं to be forgiven, मे by me, यत् that which, एतत् this, भाषितं spoken, त्वया by you, यत् that which, एतावत् so much, मया by me, कालं time, दूत O messenger, तस्य his, तु but, मर्षितम् endured.

40020390.author: Translation
40020390.content: O messenger, what you have spoken is not to be forgiven by me, though I have endured his (Kubera's) actions for so long.

40020391.author: पदार्थः
40020391.content: न not, हन्तव्यो to be killed, गुरुः preceptor, ज्येष्ठो elder brother, मया by me, अयं this (one), इति thus, मन्यते (he) thinks, तस्य his, तु but, इदानीं now, श्रुत्वा having heard, मे my, वाक्यं word, एषा this, कृता made, मतिः decision.

40020391.author: Translation
40020391.content: He (Kubera) thinks that this elder brother, my preceptor, should not be killed by me, but having now heard my words, this decision has been made by me.

40020392.author: पदार्थः
40020392.content: त्रीँल् three, लोकान् worlds, अपि even, जेष्यामि I shall conquer, बाहुवीर्यम् strength of arms, उपाश्रितः having resorted to.

40020392.author: Translation
40020392.content: Relying on the strength of my arms, I shall conquer even the three worlds.

40020393.author: पदार्थः
40020393.content: एतत् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, एव only, अहं I, तस्य his, एकस्य one (Kubera's), तु but, वै indeed, कृते for the sake of, चतुरो four, लोकपालांस् world-protectors, तान् those, नयिष्यामि I shall lead, यमक्षयम् to Yama's abode.

40020393.author: Translation
40020393.content: Indeed, for the sake of that one (Kubera) alone, I shall, in this very moment, lead those four world-protectors to Yama's abode.

40020394.author: पदार्थः
40020394.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, तु indeed, लङ्केशो the lord of Lanka (Ravana), दूतं the messenger, खड्गेन with a sword, जघ्निवान् killed, ददौ gave, भक्षयितुं to devour, हि indeed, एनं him, राक्षसानां to the Rākṣasas, दुरात्मनाम् wicked.

40020394.author: Translation
40020394.content: Having spoken thus, Ravana, the lord of Lanka, killed the messenger with his sword and gave him to the wicked Rākṣasas to be devoured.

40020395.author: पदार्थः
40020395.content: एवं thus, कृतस्वस्त्ययनो one who had performed auspicious rites, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य having ascended, रावणः Ravana, त्रैलोक्यविजयाकाङ्क्षी desirous of conquering the three worlds, ययौ went, यत्र where, धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth.

40020395.author: Translation
40020395.content: Having thus performed auspicious rites and mounted his chariot, Ravana, desirous of conquering the three worlds, went to where Kubera, the lord of wealth, resided. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रयोदशः सर्गः ।। 13 ।। Thus ends the thirteenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
